name: Urgent Vets (Queens)
notes: 32-33 Junction Boulevard, Queens 11369 (East Elmhurst). Its own website and the Mayor's Alliance give different numbers and different hours, so ring before setting off, and have a 24-hour hospital as the fallback.

change_log.to: Late hours, not 24/7 - call for hours
change_log.note: From the dog reference workbook: "late urgent care, not 24h - call". Its website did not load for a check on 2026-11-04, so the exact hours are not confirmed.

Read in a browser on 2026-11-04. Its Queens page: "OPEN 24 HOURS", 32-33 Junction Boulevard, (718) 305-4791. Its home page lists (718) 568-6823 and (347) 370-3366 against Queens. The Mayor's Alliance lists (718) 507-5600 and Sun-Wed 12pm-10pm, Thu-Sat 10am-12am. Too much disagreement to pick one: the Queens page's number and the Mayor's Alliance's are both published, and the hours say they are not confirmed, so the listing never claims to be open now. Needs a phone call by a person.
A reviewer rang on 2026-11-04. (718) 305-4791 forwards to the Queens hospital; (718) 507-5600 is the Queens hospital at 32-33 Junction Blvd, which says it is open 24 hours, 7 days a week.
